search_history.query: Knizhnik Zamolodchikov connection Casimir tensor flatness braid monodromy primary full text
search_history.outcome: Located Kohno's complete archival paper and the Etingof–Frenkel–Kirillov AMS monograph; both contain the KZ connection and braid-monodromy treatment.

search_history.query: Etingof Frenkel Kirillov Lectures on Representation Theory and Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations full text
search_history.outcome: Opened the full monograph text and inspected the affine-current, dual-Coxeter, flatness, and braid-monodromy sections listed in the source locator. The AMS host returned a 403 to the full-PDF probe; the complete book text remained available from the identified full-text copy, and the book identity was checked against AMS catalog/endmatter.

search_history.query: Toshitake Kohno Monodromy representations of braid groups and Yang-Baxter equations PDF
search_history.outcome: Opened the complete 23-page Numdam archival PDF and read §1.1, including the connection, infinitesimal pure-braid identities, flatness criterion, pure monodromy, and equal-representation descent.

sources.title: Pavel I. Etingof, Igor B. Frenkel, and Alexander A. Kirillov Jr., Lectures on Representation Theory and Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations, AMS Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 58 (1998)
sources.locator: Lecture 1, §§1.2 and 1.4; Lecture 2, §§2.5–2.8, printed pp. 19–25; Lecture 3, §3.5, printed pp. 36–37; Lecture 8, §8.1, printed pp. 113–115.

contents.name: Affine loop algebra and its central extension, Lecture 1 §1.2

source_review.read_extent: The complete section's loop-algebra identification and central-extension convention were inspected.
source_review.supports: The algebraic-current and central-coordinate interface used to define an affine input.
source_review.limitations: The local definition pins its own smooth-loop normalization and Fourier mode rescaling; no loop-group integration or module existence is inferred.

contents.name: WZW level shift and KZ differential equations, Lecture 1 §1.4

source_review.read_extent: The KZ equation and its dual-Coxeter shift were inspected with the surrounding invariant-form convention.
source_review.supports: The basic-form parameter k+h^vee used by the WZW contract.
source_review.limitations: The KZ item in this batch fixes the actual Killing form; lem-qftx-basic-form-scale proves the explicit conversion instead of identifying the two parameters silently.

contents.name: Dual Coxeter number, normalized invariant form, and Casimir eigenvalue, Lecture 2 §2.5

source_review.read_extent: The complete section's long-root normalization, dual Coxeter definition, Casimir tensor, and adjoint eigenvalue were inspected.
source_review.supports: The scale relation between the Killing form and the root-length-two basic form.
source_review.limitations: The local lemma derives the ratio from the current Killing-form Casimir supplier and the exact highest-weight scalar; the book is supporting source context, not the proof contract.

contents.name: Affine highest-weight and integrable modules, Lecture 2 §§2.6–2.8

source_review.read_extent: The affine loop realization, level, highest-weight, and integrability definitions were inspected across the cited sections.
source_review.supports: The module data the WZW completion contract must state.
source_review.limitations: No finite-dimensionality, conformal-block factorization, or existence theorem is imported by this definition.

contents.name: Theorem 3.5.1: consistency and flatness of the KZ system, Lecture 3 §3.5

source_review.read_extent: The complete consistency argument's Casimir commutator reduction and flat-connection conclusion were inspected.
source_review.supports: The infinitesimal braid identities and flatness interface.
source_review.limitations: The source calls part of the calculation straightforward; the local proof writes out the invariant-tensor commutator, Arnold identity, curvature grouping, and monodromy construction.

contents.name: KZ local-system monodromy and the full braid action for equal modules, Lecture 8 §8.1

source_review.read_extent: The full section's pure configuration-space monodromy, unordered quotient, and equal-module condition for a full braid action were inspected.
source_review.supports: The pure/full braid distinction and the permutation-compatibility hypothesis.
source_review.limitations: The local proof makes the library's first-then-second loop-product convention explicit and does not infer unitarity.

sources.title: Toshitake Kohno, Monodromy representations of braid groups and Yang-Baxter equations, Annales de l'Institut Fourier 37 (1987), no. 4, pp. 139–160
sources.locator: §1.1, printed pp. 141–143 (PDF pp. 3–5), equations (1.1.1)–(1.1.4) and the same-module symmetric-group descent.

contents.name: Definition of the ordered configuration space and pairwise Casimir KZ connection, §1.1, equations (1.1.1)–(1.1.3)

source_review.read_extent: The connection formula, tensor-factor order, and configuration-space domain were inspected.
source_review.supports: The pairwise Casimir one-form and ordered configuration convention.
source_review.limitations: Kohno states simple Lie algebra/finite-dimensional representation hypotheses; the local definition states finite-dimensional representations of semisimple g and proves basis well-definedness from exact suppliers.

contents.name: Infinitesimal pure-braid relations and the flatness criterion, §1.1, equation (1.1.4) and following calculation

source_review.read_extent: The displayed pairwise and triple Casimir relations and their role in curvature cancellation were read in full.
source_review.supports: Disjoint-pair commutation, the triple infinitesimal braid identity, and KZ integrability.
source_review.limitations: The local proof derives the triple identity from the diagonal-invariant tensor and proves the logarithmic Arnold form relation directly.

contents.name: Pure-braid monodromy and full-braid descent for identical representations, §1.1, printed pp. 142–143

source_review.read_extent: The paragraphs identifying pure braid monodromy and requiring identical representations for symmetric-group descent were inspected.
source_review.supports: The exact condition for the KZ local system to descend to unordered configurations.
source_review.limitations: No general unitarity claim or identification with a root-of-unity SU(2) exchange is made.
